_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — bản tiếng Anh của thanso_quan_he.json (hợp đôi theo loại quan hệ). Ban biên tập viết, chờ người bản xứ duyệt. Không chấm điểm hợp / khắc.

source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. A cultural reference, not a forecast.

nguoi_yeu.tieu_de: Two people, one rhythm of love
nguoi_yeu.trong_tam: In love, what matters is that each of you feels loved in the way you need — and that you can tell each other even the hard things.
nguoi_yeu.cau_hoi_chung: This week, each of you tells the other one thing that makes you feel most loved.

ban_be.tieu_de: Two friends, two ways of keeping a friendship
ban_be.trong_tam: A friendship lasts when each of you can be yourself, you meet at a pace that suits you both, and you can be honest with each other at times.
ban_be.cau_hoi_chung: When did the two of you last tell each other something hard to hear?

dong_nghiep.tieu_de: Two ways of working, one goal
dong_nghiep.trong_tam: With a colleague, what matters is clear roles, understanding how the other person works and communicating at their pace — not being close friends.
dong_nghiep.cau_hoi_chung: In your shared project, who decides which part — have the two of you said it out loud?

sep.trong_tam: With a manager, what matters is understanding what they value, reporting in a way they take in easily and keeping your own voice.
sep.cau_hoi_chung: Have you asked your boss directly what 'doing well' looks like in your role?

gia_dinh.tieu_de: Family: two worlds under one roof
gia_dinh.trong_tam: In a family, two people do not choose each other — what matters is respecting differences, sharing responsibilities fairly and saying what you need.
gia_dinh.cau_hoi_chung: Is there something you wish this family member understood about you but have never said?

nguoi_yeu.vai: Takes the initiative, likes to set the pace of the relationship, shows love through protective action.
nguoi_yeu.can: To have their decisions respected and some freedom of their own.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Giving orders or comparing them with others; hurting their pride in front of other people.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Be direct and brief; offer choices rather than demands.

ban_be.vai: The one who rounds people up, starts the plans and stands up for friends when needed.
ban_be.can: A friend who dares to follow and dares to argue.
ban_be.tranh: Letting them decide everything, then complaining behind their back.
ban_be.cach_noi: Give honest feedback, but in private, not in front of a group.

dong_nghiep.vai: Works fast, likes owning their part of the work, often suggests new ways.
dong_nghiep.can: A clear scope of responsibility and the authority to decide within it.
dong_nghiep.tranh: Supervising every step or taking credit.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: Talk about goals and results, less about procedural detail.

sep.vai: A decisive boss who expects speed and likes people who take the initiative.
sep.can: Staff who solve problems themselves and only come to them for decisions.
sep.tranh: Bringing a problem without options; arguing one-on-one in front of the team.
sep.cach_noi: Report briefly: result → what is blocking → two proposed options.

gia_dinh.vai: The one who takes the brunt and often decides for the whole family.
gia_dinh.can: To have their role recognised and to be trusted.
gia_dinh.tranh: Challenging their authority head-on when tension is high.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Ask their opinion first, then state your own need clearly.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Gentle, attentive, remembers the small details.
nguoi_yeu.can: Reassurance that they are loved, through words and a steady presence.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Cold silence or joking about their feelings.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Be gentle, check in, and ask 'what are you thinking?'

ban_be.vai: The listener, the keeper of secrets, the peacemaker of the group.
ban_be.can: Care that flows both ways, not only when you need them.
ban_be.tranh: Only getting in touch when something is wrong.
ban_be.cach_noi: Ask about their life, not just tell them about yours.

dong_nghiep.vai: Coordinates well, supports quietly, pays attention to detail.
dong_nghiep.can: A friendly environment and recognition for their contribution.
dong_nghiep.tranh: Harsh criticism or handing over tasks without explaining them.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: Acknowledge first, give feedback second, and do it in private.

sep.vai: A gentle boss who cares about team atmosphere and avoids conflict.
sep.can: Cooperative staff who bring bad news early but tactfully.
sep.cach_noi: Talk one-on-one and frame it as 'let's work out a way together'.

gia_dinh.vai: The one who keeps the peace, often giving way so home stays calm.
gia_dinh.can: To be asked for their opinion, not to have their giving way taken for granted.
gia_dinh.tranh: Raising your voice or making them take sides.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Ask 'what do you think?' and wait until they have finished.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Fun, romantic, full of surprises, good at making the other person laugh.
nguoi_yeu.can: To be praised, to be heard, and a relationship that does not get monotonous.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Calling them childish or being cold about their ideas.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Show interest in their stories; bring up serious topics when things are relaxed.

ban_be.vai: The life of the party, the storyteller, the one who connects everyone.
ban_be.can: An appreciative audience and friends to have fun with.
ban_be.tranh: Treating them only as 'the fun one' without asking about their real life.
ban_be.cach_noi: Start with a story; ask deeper questions when they are at ease.

dong_nghiep.vai: Full of ideas, communicates well, keeps the team in good spirits.
dong_nghiep.can: Room to create and a chance to present their ideas.
dong_nghiep.tranh: Repetitive tasks for too long; shooting down ideas the moment they are voiced.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: Hear the idea out, then agree together on concrete tasks and deadlines.

sep.vai: An inspiring boss with lots of ideas, who sometimes changes direction quickly.
sep.can: Staff who can turn ideas into concrete work.
sep.tranh: Flatly rejecting ideas in a meeting.
sep.cach_noi: Note the ideas down and send back a summary of next steps to lock in the direction.

gia_dinh.vai: The one who keeps the family in good spirits and loves telling stories.
gia_dinh.can: To be listened to and appreciated.
gia_dinh.tranh: Ignoring their stories or calling them unserious.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Use humour to open a difficult conversation.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Faithful and dependable; shows love through concrete actions.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Breaking promises, sudden changes, taking what they do for granted.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Be concrete and clear; thank them for the small things they do.

ban_be.vai: A reliable friend who turns up when practical help is needed.
ban_be.tranh: Cancelling at the last minute; empty promises.
ban_be.cach_noi: Set a specific day and time; tell the truth even when it is hard to hear.

dong_nghiep.can: Clear instructions, reasonable deadlines, consistent processes.
dong_nghiep.tranh: Changing requirements all the time; sloppy work.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: Bring figures and a step-by-step plan; give advance notice of any change.

sep.vai: A meticulous boss who values process, quality and deadlines.
sep.can: Reliable, careful staff who report with figures.
sep.tranh: Taking shortcuts; missing deadlines without warning.
sep.cach_noi: Give structured reports with enough detail; ask before changing how something is done.

gia_dinh.vai: The practical pillar who handles routines, finances and housework.
gia_dinh.tranh: Brushing off house rules, mess, unplanned spending.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Discuss concrete plans and avoid vague talk.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Magnetic, adventurous, brings a sense of novelty.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Control, jealousy, holding on too tightly.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Invite them to try something new together; talk about commitment as a choice, not a tie.

ban_be.vai: The one who suggests going out, travelling, trying new things.
ban_be.can: A friend ready to 'just go' who does not mind when they disappear for a while.
ban_be.tranh: Holding them to a rigid schedule.
ban_be.cach_noi: Keep it short, fun and flexible.

dong_nghiep.vai: Flexible, good in unexpected situations, likes varied work.
dong_nghiep.can: Variety and freedom in how they do the work.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: State the goal and let them choose how; confirm in writing so nothing slips.

sep.vai: A dynamic boss who changes things quickly and likes people who adapt well.
sep.can: Flexible staff who are not afraid of new tasks.
sep.tranh: Complaining about change; clinging rigidly to the old plan.
sep.cach_noi: Offer options quickly; confirm what you agreed in a short message.

gia_dinh.vai: The one who travels, changes things and brings new stories home.
gia_dinh.can: Not to be tied down by traditional expectations.
gia_dinh.tranh: Imposing on them or scolding them for being different from the family's ways.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Be curious about their experiences before giving advice.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Caring and warm, focused on family and a shared future.
nguoi_yeu.can: Appreciation for what they do, and commitment.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Taking their care for granted; being irresponsible.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Thank them specifically; say which part you want to take care of yourself.

ban_be.vai: A thoughtful friend who often helps and gives advice.
ban_be.can: Recognition, and to be asked about in return.
ban_be.tranh: Taking advantage of their kindness; brushing off their advice.
ban_be.cach_noi: Thank them for the advice, then say clearly what you have decided.

dong_nghiep.vai: Dedicated, looks out for the whole team, keeps things warm.
dong_nghiep.can: A respectful workplace and fair treatment.
dong_nghiep.tranh: Pushing your work onto them because you know they find it hard to say no.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: Be gentle and appreciative; take on your own share of the work.

sep.vai: A boss who cares for staff like family and takes responsibility seriously.
sep.tranh: Indifference to the team; working only for yourself.
sep.cach_noi: Share personal difficulties when they affect the work; propose shared solutions.

gia_dinh.vai: The one who looks after everyone, remembers every occasion and keeps family traditions.
gia_dinh.tranh: Letting them carry everything, then calling them a nag.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Take on specific tasks; say 'let me handle this part'.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Deep and private; falls in love slowly and sincerely.
nguoi_yeu.can: Quiet time of their own and conversations with depth.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Pressing them to show feelings right away; intruding on their privacy.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Ask open questions and give them time to think; talk about ideas and meaning.

ban_be.vai: Has few friends but good ones, and gives sharp advice.
ban_be.can: Respect when they need to be alone.
ban_be.tranh: Blaming them for disappearing; dragging them into noisy crowds.
ban_be.cach_noi: Meet one-on-one and talk properly; message when needed without expecting an instant reply.

dong_nghiep.vai: Deep expertise, strong analysis, likes working independently.
dong_nghiep.tranh: Pointless meetings; rushing them before the facts are in.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: Send the problem in writing first so they have time to think.

sep.vai: An expert boss who says little and expects quality and tight reasoning.
sep.can: Knowledgeable staff who work carefully and back things up.
sep.cach_noi: Lay out clear reasoning with data; welcome tough questions.

gia_dinh.vai: A quiet family member who needs their own space at home.
gia_dinh.can: To be left alone when needed, and understood as not being cold.
gia_dinh.tranh: Reading their silence as sulking or indifference.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Ask briefly, and start conversations with topics they care about.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Strong and protective, focused on securing the material future.
nguoi_yeu.can: Respect for their abilities and a partner who shares their drive.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Belittling their failures; competing for power in public.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Be frank and clear; talk about shared goals.

ban_be.vai: An influential, generous friend who often connects people with opportunities.
ban_be.tranh: Only getting in touch when you need help or money.
ban_be.cach_noi: Be direct and to the point; acknowledge their successes.

dong_nghiep.can: Efficient colleagues who do not waste time.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: Go straight to the numbers and the results.

sep.vai: A powerful, demanding boss who looks at results.
sep.tranh: Making excuses; challenging their authority in front of others.
sep.cach_noi: Open with results and figures; make proposals with the benefits worked out.

gia_dinh.vai: The one who handles the family finances and has a big say at home.
gia_dinh.tranh: Arguing about money in front of outsiders.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Discuss money clearly, with a plan.

nguoi_yeu.can: To have their ideals understood and to be loved for their fragile side too.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Mocking their dreams; being selfish or petty.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Talk about meaning and values; gently bring it back to concrete things.

ban_be.vai: A generous friend who helps without keeping score.
ban_be.can: Sincerity and doing meaningful things together.
ban_be.cach_noi: Share honestly; invite them to do something good together.

dong_nghiep.vai: Sees the big picture, inspires others, cares about social impact.
dong_nghiep.can: To see that the work means something.
dong_nghiep.tranh: Talking only about profit and ignoring values.
dong_nghiep.cach_noi: Say 'who does this help?', then settle on concrete tasks.

sep.vai: A visionary, humane boss who is sometimes far from practicalities.
sep.can: Staff who share the values and help make them real.
sep.tranh: Belittling the mission; chasing targets only.
sep.cach_noi: Link your proposals to the shared vision; bring a realistic plan.

gia_dinh.vai: A big-hearted person who looks out for the wider family and community.
gia_dinh.can: Understanding, and someone to share the load.
gia_dinh.tranh: Harshly blaming them for caring about outsiders more than family.
gia_dinh.cach_noi: Gently tell them that the family needs them too.
